records.name: Sir Cedric Flinch
records.biography_en: Cedric guards a HyperNorm gate whose official threat level has never dropped below magnificent. He checks the sword before every shift because the gate has no hinges.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I asked him which side of the gate was safe. He indicated the shield.

records.name: Orlo Spindle
records.biography_en: Orlo was hired to teach an orb to summarize unwelcome evidence. It now gives the evidence twice and pauses for questions.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He has begun referring to the orb as a colleague so he can formally ignore it.

records.name: Vera Cutpurse
records.biography_en: Vera steals only items that the Men in Black have formally declared never existed. Her bag has become too heavy to deny.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I searched the pouch. She helpfully returned my watch before I asked.

records.name: Rowan Featherdraw
records.biography_en: Rowan tracks contradictions through the scrub around HyperNorm. She marks the places where the official tracks double back.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The arrow was straighter than any account of what happened next.

records.name: Bram Stillbell
records.biography_en: Bram rings one note whenever a HyperNorm instruction contradicts itself. He was transferred to a room with excellent soundproofing.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: His official response time is one breath. The appeal takes considerably longer.

records.name: Hob Hornwhistle
records.biography_en: Hob trained a horned creature to find censored evidence. It currently finds his lunch and a little more evidence than necessary.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The companion's official job title is Assistance. Its teeth are informal.
